objective: Close a source-side critical-defect enforcement gap where visibly significant untouched Unity stock Plane/Quad meshes could evade the benchmark primitive-placeholder preflight even though the canonical Visual Fidelity Gate treats visible primitive-placeholder geometry as automatic FAIL.

finding.problem: QualityBlockBenchmarkPrimitiveExposureQA screened Cube, Cylinder, Sphere and Capsule but explicitly exempted the built-in Plane and Quad. The exemption was broader than the canonical critical-defect intent: planar topology can be legitimate, but a large untouched stock Plane/Quad in hero, oblique or grazing framing is still primitive-placeholder risk.
finding.whyItMatters: A stock planar primitive could have entered reflection, still and temporal evidence without triggering the integrated source preflight. This could falsely weaken enforcement of the geometry/construction category and the automatic visible_primitive_placeholder failure condition.
finding.decision: Keep physically justified planar topology legal, but require legitimate thin carriers to use purpose-built authored/generated meshes with applicable construction/material metadata. Screen untouched Unity Plane and Quad under the same exact projected-bound thresholds as the other stock primitives.

implementation: Expanded the stock primitive mesh set to Cube, Cylinder, Sphere, Capsule, Plane and Quad.
Preserved the exact QualityBlock4KCapture hero/oblique/grazing framing lock, 3840x2160 source projection, near-plane fail-closed behavior and existing pixel thresholds.
Changed the contract critical-defect reference to the canonical Visual Fidelity Gate ID visible_primitive_placeholder.
Added an explicit machine-readable screenStockPlaneAndQuad=true policy while stating that planar topology itself is not forbidden.

Updated corrective actions so legitimate planar carriers must use purpose-built authored/generated meshes with applicable construction/material metadata instead of evading the gate through rename/hide/shrink/threshold exceptions.
Versioned the primitive exposure contract/runtime report shape to 1.1 and renamed the report count to inspectedStockPrimitiveRendererCount.
Retained visualFidelityPointsAwarded=0 and criticalDefectClearedBySourcePass=false; source preflight cannot claim rendered quality.

commits.message: qa: screen stock planar primitives in benchmark views
qa: harden primitive exposure contract for planar stock meshes

verification.startToImplementationHeadCompare: 2 commits ahead / 0 behind; merge base remains startingHead; only two UnityProject files changed before this run record

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryConstruction: Enforcement improvement only: reduces risk that an obvious stock planar placeholder reaches formal evidence. No Geometry points awarded without rendered pixels.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.criticalDefect: Strengthens automatic FAIL coverage for visible_primitive_placeholder across all six Unity built-in primitive mesh types.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.otherCategories: No visual points claimed; this run intentionally prioritizes gate integrity over speculative art expansion while Unity runtime remains unavailable.

If a visible stock Plane/Quad or other stock primitive violation is found, reconstruct/replace it with physically justified authored/generated geometry rather than weakening the gate.
Run the complete native-4K review packet, capture hero/oblique/grazing at 3840x2160 plus 100% crops, and score only from actual rendered evidence.
